newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pilots call Thursday strike at Air France Europe.
newsitem.headline: Pilots call Thursday strike at Air France Europe.

text.p: Air France Europe said Wednesday pilots called a 24-hour strike for Thursday and that all flights would be cancelled except those to the island of Corsica and a limited number to three French towns from Paris.

Air France Europe, the domestic and short-haul division of Air France, issued a statement condemning the strike called by several unions as "suicidal" and saying it would not give in to "blackmail" from the best paid pilots in the world.

The pilots, protesting plans for a full merger with parent company Air France, had cost the airline more than 1 billion French francs ($174.8 million) through industrial action over the past five years, the airline said.
A similar snap strike by pilots grounded flights to all destinations except the French Mediterranean island of Corsica on Feb. 9.
